svg.aria-label: First set the target size: in a sandwich cell, the film fills the hole of the PTFE spacer and its thickness equals the spacer thickness; in a coin cell, use an 18 to 19 mm disc, a size larger than the 16 mm spacer; with a PP ring, fill the hole and scrape it flat.
